title: A generalisation of g-rectifying and g-normal curves in Lorentzian n-space
summary: In this paper, we introduce and analyze $g-$rectifying curves (spacelike and null curves) and $\ g-$normal curves in Lorentzian $n$-space, building upon the established notion of rectifying curves and normal curve, respectively. Our generalization extends this definition by considering an $% g-$position vector field, $ξ_{g}(s)=\int g(s)dξ$, where $g$ is an integrable function in the arc-length parameter $s$.
